ACCOUNT.comment: Bank accounts held at a Czech retail bank in the 1990s: one row per account. Each account is held at a bank branch located in a district, and has a set frequency for issuing account statements. All money amounts in this database are in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.DISTRICT_ID: The district where the bank branch holding the account is located.
columns.FREQUENCY: How often account statements are issued, as a Czech code: 'POPLATEK MESICNE' = monthly issuance; 'POPLATEK TYDNE' = weekly issuance; 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' = issuance after each transaction.
columns.DATE: Date the account was opened, as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

CARD.comment: Payment (credit) cards issued by the bank: one row per card. A card is issued to a person for a specific account that person is allowed to use.

columns.DISP_ID: The person-and-account right (disposition) the card was issued for.
columns.TYPE: Card level: 'junior', 'classic' or 'gold'. Gold is the highest (premium) level, classic the standard level and junior the entry level.
columns.ISSUED: Date the card was issued, as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

CLIENT.comment: Customers of the bank: one row per person.

columns.BIRTH_DATE: Date of birth, as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
columns.DISTRICT_ID: The district where the client lives (their home address). This can differ from the district of the branch where their account is held.

DISP.comment: Dispositions: which people have the right to use which accounts. One row per person-and-account pair. Every account has exactly one owner and may also have other people authorised to use it.

columns.DISP_ID: Identifier of the disposition (one person's right to use one account).
columns.TYPE: 'OWNER' = the account holder, who owns the account; 'DISPONENT' = another person authorised to use the account but who does not own it.

DISTRICT.comment: Demographic and economic statistics for each district (okres) of the Czech Republic in the mid-1990s: one row per district. A district is a local administrative area; districts are grouped into 8 regions. The statistics columns are named X01 to X15; their meanings are given below.

columns.X01: Number of municipalities in the district with 500 to 1,999 inhabitants.
columns.X02: Number of municipalities in the district with 2,000 to 9,999 inhabitants.
columns.X03: Region the district belongs to. One of 8 regions: 'Prague', 'central Bohemia', 'south Bohemia', 'west Bohemia', 'north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia', 'south Moravia', 'north Moravia'. Prague is a region of its own with a single district.
columns.X04: Number of crimes committed in the district in 1996 (a count, not a rate).
columns.X05: Average monthly salary in the district, in Czech crowns (CZK).
columns.X06: District name, written without Czech accents, e.g. 'Benesov', 'Kladno', 'Brno - mesto'. 'Hl.m. Praha' is the capital city, Prague.
columns.X07: Number of inhabitants (population) of the district.
columns.X08: Unemployment rate in 1996, as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 means 3.5%).
columns.X09: Number of municipalities in the district with 10,000 or more inhabitants.
columns.X10: Number of cities (towns) in the district.
columns.X11: Number of municipalities in the district with fewer than 500 inhabitants.
columns.X12: Unemployment rate in 1995, as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 means 3.5%). Unknown (NULL) for the district of Jesenik.
columns.X13: Number of crimes committed in the district in 1995 (a count, not a rate). Unknown (NULL) for the district of Jesenik.
columns.X14: Ratio of urban inhabitants: the percentage of the district's population living in towns.

LOAN.comment: Loans granted by the bank to accounts: one row per loan. An account has at most one loan. Amounts are in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the loan was granted to.
columns.DATE: Date the loan was granted (approved), as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
columns.AMOUNT: Total amount of the loan, CZK.
columns.DURATION: Length of the loan in months: 12, 24, 36, 48 or 60.
columns.PAYMENTS: Monthly repayment amount, CZK (the loan AMOUNT equals PAYMENTS multiplied by DURATION). An amount of money, not a count of payments.
columns.STATUS: State of the loan, as a code: 'A' = contract finished, no problems; 'B' = contract finished, loan not paid back; 'C' = contract still running, payments OK so far; 'D' = contract still running, client in debt. Finished loans are A or B; running (active) loans are C or D; loans in good standing are A or C; problem loans are B or D.

ORDER.comment: Payment orders (standing orders): instructions to pay money regularly from an account to a recipient's account, possibly at another bank. One row per order. Amounts are in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the money is paid from.
columns.BANK_TO: Two-letter code of the recipient's bank, e.g. 'AB' or 'YZ'.
columns.AMOUNT: Amount paid by the order, CZK.
columns.K_SYMBOL: Purpose of the payment, as a Czech code: 'SIPO' = household payment (e.g. utilities); 'UVER' = loan repayment; 'POJISTNE' = insurance payment; 'LEASING' = leasing payment. An empty value means the purpose is not specified.

TRANS.comment: Transactions on bank accounts: one row per movement of money into or out of an account. Amounts and balances are in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the transaction is on.
columns.DATE: Date of the transaction, as text in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
columns.TYPE: Direction of the money, as a Czech code: 'PRIJEM' = credit (money in); 'VYDAJ' = debit (money out); 'VYBER' = cash withdrawal (also money out). A withdrawal is either VYDAJ or VYBER.
columns.OPERATION: How the money moved, as a Czech code: 'VYBER' = withdrawal in cash; 'VYBER KARTOU' = credit card withdrawal; 'VKLAD' = credit (deposit) in cash; 'PREVOD Z UCTU' = collection (incoming transfer) from another bank; 'PREVOD NA UCET' = remittance (outgoing transfer) to another bank. Empty (NULL) for interest credited by the bank.
columns.AMOUNT: Amount of money moved, CZK. Always positive; TYPE gives the direction.
columns.BALANCE: Account balance after the transaction, CZK. Can be negative (overdrawn).
columns.K_SYMBOL: Purpose of the transaction, as a Czech code: 'UROK' = interest credited; 'SANKC. UROK' = penalty interest charged on a negative balance; 'SLUZBY' = payment for the account statement (bank charge); 'SIPO' = household payment; 'DUCHOD' = old-age pension; 'POJISTNE' = insurance payment; 'UVER' = loan repayment. Not specified when empty (NULL) or a single space.
columns.BANK: Two-letter code of the other party's bank for transfers, e.g. 'AB' or 'YZ'. Empty (NULL) when there is no other bank.
columns.ACCOUNT: The other party's account number for transfers. Empty (NULL) or 0 when there is no other account.
